description:
The memory-first coding agent

Letta Code is a memory-first coding harness, designed for long-lived agents that can learn from experience.
Instead of working in independent sessions, you work with a persisted agent whose memory is portable across models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, Kimi, and more).
What's Changed
- fix(tools): preserve line endings in ApplyPatch updates by @amelia-letta in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4996
- fix(listener): register channel external tools during startup by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4999
- feat(browser-discovery): detect Letta Code on this device by @4shub in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4998
- fix(listener): do not publish turn_finished on a teleport handoff [LET-13834] by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/5002
- chore: bump version to 0.34.8 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/5003
Full Changelog: https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/compare/v0.34.7...v0.34.8
